title: BPW-2026-0538
text:
[BUREAU OF ENGINEERING]
BPW-2026-0538
CD 8
CONSTRUCTION BUDGET AND REVISED CONSTRUCTION ORDERS AND CHANGE ORDERS – TOMOVICH & ASSOCIATES
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a construction budget of $223,816 including contingency for the Super Expedited Wastewater Emergency Rehabilitation for Sewers Program – 57th Street (1500) Project; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue revised construction orders and change orders up to the authorized construction budget for this project.
(W.O.: SZC14569, C-140017)
summary: The Board is asked to approve a $223,816 construction budget for an emergency sewer rehabilitation on 57th Street, and to let the City Engineer issue change orders up to that budget.

details.action: construction budget and change order authority
